log: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 2). Honey is antibacterial. Sugar packs wounds. Yarrow stops bleeding. The old ways work.
📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 2). You can talk someone down from a full panic attack. Voice low, steady, certain. You are the calm.
📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 2). You can function through terror. Your hands shake but they work. This is a trained skill.
📖 Your old life taught you things. 3 skills from your past — check your Journal.
Nothing here looks like home. You know none of these plants. Learn fast.
📖 Your hands remember: knap a Stone knife (stone + vine) — the oldest tool there is. Find the stone.
📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Nora Costa. Army medic. From Minneapolis, USA. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dead Phone, Dog tags, Field suture kit, Home key, Trail compass. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
🐞 SCENARIO: hummice. The grass is humming in harmony, four tiles east. Four of them.
The humming gets louder. It's coming toward the sound of you.
The grass is humming. In harmony. That's not grass — that's fifty throats, one note, and it's getting louder.
Your teeth ache with it. You don't know what it wants.
You don't know what that was. the humming in the grass Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE HUMMING IN THE GRASS! (4 of them!) You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.

⚠️ 1 threats: the humming in the grass 1 (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

💥 It erupts!

You're not where it landed. Clean dodge.

One mouse is a snack. Fifty mice is a meal. Do the math. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You clutch your Dead Phone, Dog Tags, Field suture kit, Home key, Trail compass. You're still here.
